title: As sustained heatwaves increase the risk of infectious diseases across Europe, ECDC scales up action and calls for cooperation
summary: The risk of catching some infectious diseases is growing amidst longer, warmer summers across Europe, making close cooperation across borders and sectors vital to predict, prevent, and respond effectively, ECDC said today.

title: World Hepatitis Day 2026: Ensuring that life-saving interventions are accessible to everyone who needs them is a common challenge
summary: World Hepatitis Day is an opportunity to raise awareness of the risk of contracting hepatitis and the health threats it can bring, while at the same time recognising the progress Europe has made to strengthen prevention.

title: World Hepatitis Day 2026: Despite progress towards eliminating hepatitis in Europe, gaps in prevention measures keep 2030 targets out of reach
summary: While Europe has made steady progress in preventing hepatitis B and C the region is set to miss the 2030 target to eliminate viral hepatitis as a public health threat.
